name: flixeok
description: Flixeok Android Video Editor by FTTHBD

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['index.html','manifest.json','pv.js','sw.js'])if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f);if(!fs.existsSync('www/index.html'))throw Error('index.html not found')"
